name: b-ordinary-skip

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12

purpose: ordinary SKIP before projection; indexed string source

name: b-distinct-skip

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id AS missing, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name SKIP 3 LIMIT 12

purpose: qualified DISTINCT exhausts sources for provenance

name: b-ordinary-order-parallel

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.id AS id, n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY name, id SKIP 2 LIMIT 12

purpose: ordinary direct-string ORDER; source parallel eligible when main strategy permits

name: b-ordinary-order-generic-serial

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-android-00' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id DESC SKIP 2 LIMIT 12

purpose: generic serial ORDER; route one actual source; complete source scan

name: b-distinct-order-retained

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller ORDER BY caller SKIP 0 LIMIT 2

purpose: one visible class repeated; retained duplicates merge provenance

name: b-distinct-order-eviction-candidate

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS name ORDER BY n.callee_name DESC SKIP 0 LIMIT 2

purpose: small retained heap with repeated method keys and varying ORDER; eviction/reappearance to be confirmed by actual capture, not asserted

name: b-order-duplicate-alias-ties

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN n.caller_name AS x, n.callee_name AS x ORDER BY x SKIP 2 LIMIT 8

purpose: duplicate alias overwrite; tied callee names

name: b-distinct-order-callee

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class = 'com.google.android.mms.util.PduCache' RETURN DISTINCT n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS name ORDER BY name DESC, callee SKIP 1 LIMIT 3

purpose: retained DISTINCT heap, stable ties/eviction and provenance
